changes.reason: Cell-by-cell comparison of the cached Skadi tiles with SRTMGL1 v3 from the ESA mirror: N46E009 99.72 %, N46E010 99.81 %, N47E009 99.50 %, N47E010 99.68 %, N47E016 99.84 % identical cells, mean absolute difference 0.002-0.019 m (pointed out by session anfaelligkeit_at_v01, verified here). Skadi 1 arc-second over Austria is therefore practically SRTMGL1 (acquisition February 2000), not the data.gv.at laser-scan DGM; the Tilezen data-source table refers to the high-zoom terrain formats.
changes.consequence: SRTM remains the primary DEM and satisfies the provenance rule; there is no train/test DEM shift (the V0.4 model was trained on practically the same heights). The registered statement that Skadi does not satisfy the provenance rule is withdrawn.
